findings.detail: Whole-account daily aggregation accepts coverage.until immediately after the regular calendar close. A creation-time query ending at 16:10 New York omits later same-day activity, including after-hours executions; exact penny-rounded fee matching on the retained subset cannot establish a complete account-day denominator. Post-close executed assessments do not prove the remaining day has no fills or adjustments. The code returns unqualified ACCOUNT_DAY_FEE_SOURCE_PASS for this truncated interval.
findings.requested_fix: Require complete account trade-day coverage with explicit delayed-creation limits, or validate a source-pinned regular-session-only scope; otherwise label provisional observed components instead of whole-day PASS.
findings.title: Require full account-day coverage or a proven regular-session-only scope

findings.detail: Every FILL is treated as NMS shares and qty*price as USD sell value without asset-class/currency applicability checks. Capture-verified rows explicitly marked asset_class=crypto and symbol=BTC/USD still produce ACCOUNT_DAY_FEE_SOURCE_PASS when retained penny fee totals match. A pinned NMS-share/SEC-equity protocol does not extend to arbitrary account instruments. Mixed/unsupported activity can therefore produce false model reconciliation even while finality flags stay false.
findings.requested_fix: Validate source-pinned supported asset/currency scope for every fill; reject explicit unsupported/conflicting instruments and keep unresolved days outside equity-model PASS.
findings.title: Validate instrument and currency applicability before applying the NMS/SEC fee model

scope: Only reconcile_account_day_fees and new fee-day tests; collector R1/R2 fixes not reviewed again.
